name: Unsewn Undead: Head and Chest
body:
UNSEWN UNDEAD: HEAD AND CHEST
CR 1/3

XP 135
CE Small undead
Init +0; darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 size, +1 natural)
hp 9 (2d8)
Fort +0, Ref +0, Will +3
Defensive Abilities Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +2 (1d4+1)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 10, Con —, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 11
Feats Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Climb +9, Perception +4, Stealth +11
Languages —
SQ undead traits

ABOUT

This grotesque horror consists of a human head and ribcage severed at the midriff, dragging its exposed spine across the floor with two clawed hands.

It hides behind doors and beneath furniture, lunging upward to bite travelers while its detached lower limbs and flying hands attack from other angles.
